title: Ghame Shabbir Amanat
body:
ghame shabbir amanat hai mere seene mein
ek yehi baat hai jo dil hai laga jeene mein
<<DIVIDER>>
tera banda e ali hai ke khudaya tune
apni tasveer saja rakhi hai aaene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ran mein hamshakle payambar ko na bheje maula
koi barchi na utar aaye kahin seene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye musalman ajab dushmane paighambar hai
dekh sakte nahi tasveer hi aaene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
<<DIVIDER>>
bacha cheh maah ka tha saamne darya tha rawan
kya ghata jaata tha do ghoont bhala peene mein
ghame shabbir amanat...
